name: Stock Report
sql_query:
SELECT
    i.item_code,
    i.item_description,
    c.name                                                              AS category_name,
    b.name                                                              AS brand_name,
    COALESCE(stk.opening_qty, 0)                                       AS opening_qty,
    COALESCE(stk.qty_in, 0)                                            AS qty_in,
    COALESCE(stk.qty_out, 0)                                           AS qty_out,
    COALESCE(stk.closing_qty, 0)                                       AS closing_qty,
    i.reorder_level,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(stk.closing_qty, 0) <= 0 
            THEN 'Out of Stock'
        WHEN i.reorder_level > 0 AND COALESCE(stk.closing_qty, 0) <= i.reorder_level 
            THEN 'Reorder Alert'
        ELSE 'In Stock'
    END AS stock_status
FROM items i
LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = i.category_id
LEFT JOIN m_brands b ON b.id = i.brand_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        m.item_code,
        SUM(CASE WHEN :from IS NOT NULL AND m.dDate < :from THEN m.qun_in - m.qun_out ELSE 0 END) AS opening_qty,
        SUM(CASE WHEN (:from IS NULL OR m.dDate >= :from) AND (:to IS NULL OR m.dDate <= :to) THEN m.qun_in ELSE 0 END) AS qty_in,
        SUM(CASE WHEN (:from IS NULL OR m.dDate >= :from) AND (:to IS NULL OR m.dDate <= :to) THEN m.qun_out ELSE 0 END) AS qty_out,
        SUM(CASE WHEN :to IS NULL OR m.dDate <= :to THEN m.qun_in - m.qun_out ELSE 0 END) AS closing_qty
    FROM t_item_movements m
    WHERE m.BC = :bc
      AND (:store_id IS NULL OR m.store_id = :store_id)
      AND (:to IS NULL OR m.dDate <= :to)
    GROUP BY m.item_code
) stk ON stk.item_code = i.item_code
WHERE i.BC = :bc
  AND (:category IS NULL OR i.category_id = :category OR c.parent_id = :category)
  AND (:brand_id IS NULL OR i.brand_id = :brand_id)
  AND (:search IS NULL OR i.item_code LIKE CONCAT('%', :search, '%')
                       OR i.item_description LIKE CONCAT('%', :search, '%'))
  AND (
      :stock_status IS NULL
      OR :stock_status = ''
      OR :stock_status = 'ALL'
      OR (:stock_status = 'IN_STOCK' AND COALESCE(stk.closing_qty, 0) > 0)
      OR (:stock_status = 'OUT_OF_STOCK' AND COALESCE(stk.closing_qty, 0) <= 0)
      OR (:stock_status = 'REORDER' AND i.reorder_level > 0 AND COALESCE(stk.closing_qty, 0) <= i.reorder_level)
  )
ORDER BY i.item_code;
